tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, behind every surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the sidebar, dialogs and inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Section header rows, neutral pills, the selected nav item.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and on secondary and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, currency codes and placeholder text on bg, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, card outlines, the meter track. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons on surface and bg.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button per view. Tally has no brand hue: the brand is ink.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every focusable control, on bg and surface.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Money available or coming in: text on positive-soft and on surface, and the meter fill while within budget.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the available pill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Close to the limit or underfunded: text on warning-soft and on surface, and the meter fill above 90%.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the warning pill.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Overspent, negative balances and field errors: text on negative-soft and on surface, and the meter fill when over budget.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the overspent pill.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Phone top bar and tab bar, with a 20px blur. Content scrolls under it. Text on it is ink, never ink-muted.

tokens.name: glass-thick
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheets, with a 30px blur. Thicker than glass so form fields stay easy to read.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a dialog or a sheet.

tokens.name: sec-1
tokens.usage: First section a person creates (for example Needs): its dot and its allocation segment. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-2
tokens.usage: Second section (Wants). Never text.

tokens.name: sec-3
tokens.usage: Third section (Savings). Never text.

tokens.name: sec-4
tokens.usage: Fourth section (for example a tax-style section such as Zakat). Never text.

tokens.name: sec-5
tokens.usage: Fifth section. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-6
tokens.usage: Sixth section. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-7
tokens.usage: Seventh section. Never text.

tokens.name: sec-8
tokens.usage: Eighth section. A ninth folds into Other, drawn in ink-muted.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: The page title: the month, or the page name. One per page.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Dialog titles and card group titles.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Running text, row names, input text.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Notes under a row, hints, converted amounts. Set in ink-muted.

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Column and field labels, uppercase, in ink-muted.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every amount in a row or a table. Tabular figures, right-aligned.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: A pocket balance or a month stat.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The one headline figure of a page, such as net worth.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a dot and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control or between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a table row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of rows and the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter and the gap between page blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a page title on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and allocation segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, section tables and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, dots and meters.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only. Cards are flat with a line outline.
